W.note: Good ARIA and a restore dot, but the collapsed ETA truncates to 'Arrive...' and the tracking number wraps awkwardly when open.

X.note: Very tight with a progress bar and clean timeline, but the open card has dead space at the bottom, a tiny triangle toggle, and no live-region announcement.

Y.note: Richest tracker (package switcher, carrier, ETA, dated timeline, refresh/alerts/copy) with a green accent that holds on dark and a still-compact footprint.

Z.note: Clear timeline with location detail and a next-action note plus an edge-tab restore, though the ETA is only 'Thu' and the Copy number button wraps.
